card: Backports merged PR #36404 to the 32.x maintenance branch. It removes setting random state for the private broadcast fuzz test. This ensures the 32.x branch receives the same fuzz test fix already merged into master.
evidence: Commit message cites merged upstream pull request #36404 ("fuzz: don't set random state for private broadcast test")
problem: The 32.x maintenance branch lacks a fix applied on master to the private broadcast fuzz test.

risk.why: A flaw in backporting a fuzz test change would only affect fuzz testing on the 32.x release branch.

scope_notes: Backport PR targeting the 32.x branch consisting of a single commit from #36404.
summary: Backports PR #36404 to the 32.x release branch. Specifically, it applies a single commit to prevent setting random state in the private broadcast fuzz test.
